reason: Protected-column residual correction semantics are specified and testable in PyTorch, but no residual-correction method has survived ParoQuant-held-out smoke or partial evaluation.
promote_to_gpu_smoke_if: C5 residual-correction candidate pool identifies calibration-only protected columns
ParoQuant tail or weak traces are identified with held-out confirmation traces
The smoke command includes ParoQuant baseline in the same protocol
The candidate preserves matched budget/overhead accounting
promote_to_kernel_implementation_if: A residual-correction finalist beats ParoQuant median by >= 0.05 on confirmation traces
or improves ParoQuant CI lower bound/CVaR tail substantially without median loss > 0.05
and a separate PyTorch reference comparison passes on model-realistic shapes
kill_or_defer_if: Residual columns only improve calibration traces
DeltaW column norms are nearly flat and selector collapses to activation magnitude
Required protected fraction is too large to preserve W4A16 memory/latency advantage
KLLOOK ceiling is low for the target model
novelty_note: Do not claim mixed-precision columns as novel. Safe claim, if validated, is drift-aware residual correction after rotation for long-reasoning W4A16.
